title: Warm Nourishing Anti-Dryness Diet for Acne
text: Favor warm, lightly oiled, nourishing meals to prevent the dryness that can worsen Vata-type flaky acne; avoid excess raw, cold, or dry foods.

title: Vata Acne Stress-Routine Anchor
text: Keep a steady daily routine with regular sleep and gentle stress reduction; irregular routines can aggravate Vata and worsen breakout cycles.

title: Light Oil-Balanced Cleansing for Dry Acne
text: Use a mild, non-stripping cleanser and a light non-comedogenic oil-based moisturizer to avoid over-drying skin that is already Vata-prone to flaking.

title: Light Spiced Detox Meals for Congested Acne
text: Favor light, warm, mildly spiced meals and reduce heavy, oily, or very sweet/dairy foods that can increase Kapha-related congestion and breakouts.

title: Kapha Acne Circulation and Sweat Routine
text: Include regular brisk movement to support circulation and healthy sweating, which may help reduce Kapha-type congestion contributing to breakouts.

title: Clay and Oil-Control Cleansing for Kapha Acne
text: Use a gentle clarifying cleanser and, where tolerated, a light clay mask to help manage excess oiliness without over-stripping the skin.

title: Cooling Hydration Plate for Sensitive Dry Skin
text: Favor cooling, hydrating foods and reduce very spicy, fried, or sour foods that may increase Pitta-related sensitivity alongside dryness.

title: Heat-Aware Routine for Dry Sensitive Skin
text: Limit prolonged heat and sun exposure, which can further dry and irritate Pitta-prone sensitive skin; prefer cooler times of day for outdoor activity.

title: Cooling Barrier Moisturizing for Dry Pitta Skin
text: Use a fragrance-free, cooling, barrier-supportive moisturizer rather than heavy or heating formulations, applied soon after cleansing.

title: Light Warm Oiled Meals for Kapha Dry Skin
text: Include a small amount of healthy warm oils in meals to support skin moisture, while keeping overall meals light and avoiding excess heavy or cold foods.

title: Gentle Movement and Circulation for Dry Kapha Skin
text: Regular gentle movement can support circulation, which may help distribute natural moisture and improve dull, dry-feeling Kapha skin.

title: Light Oil Massage for Kapha-Type Dryness
text: A light, warm oil massage (abhyanga-style) before bathing may help support skin moisture without adding heaviness; use sparingly if skin tends oily elsewhere.

title: Light Astringent Diet for Weepy Eczema
text: Favor light, warm, mildly astringent foods and reduce heavy, oily, or very sweet foods that may increase Kapha-related congestion and oozing patterns.

title: Kapha Eczema Dry-Keeping Routine
text: Keep affected areas clean and dry, with regular gentle movement to support circulation; avoid prolonged dampness which can worsen weepy patches.

title: Light Non-Occlusive Care for Kapha Eczema
text: Use a light, breathable barrier cream rather than heavy occlusive ointments, which may trap moisture and worsen congested, weepy Kapha-type eczema.

title: Warm Nourishing Diet for Dry Fungal Patches
text: Favor warm, lightly oiled, nourishing meals to support overall skin resilience; avoid excess dry, cold, or raw foods while managing a dry-type fungal patch.

title: Gentle Warmth and Routine for Dry Fungal Areas
text: Maintain a steady daily routine and avoid prolonged cold or dry air exposure on affected areas, which may worsen cracking.

title: Light Oil-Based Antifungal Care for Cracking Skin
text: Keep the area clean and dry per clinical guidance, and use a light, non-greasy moisturizer around (not directly on) active lesions to reduce cracking.

title: Cooling Anti-Inflammatory Diet for Irritated Fungal Patches
text: Favor cooling, mildly bitter foods and reduce spicy, fried, or very sour foods that may increase heat and irritation around inflamed fungal patches.

title: Heat and Sweat Management for Inflamed Fungal Areas
text: Reduce prolonged heat exposure and change out of sweaty clothing promptly, since excess heat and moisture can aggravate Pitta-type inflamed fungal patches.

title: Cooling Antifungal Hygiene Routine
text: Keep the area clean and dry per clinical guidance, and use cool (not hot) water when cleansing inflamed, burning fungal patches.

title: Warm Grounding Diet for Stress-Linked Hives
text: Favor warm, grounding, regular meals; skipped or irregular meals can aggravate Vata and may correlate with stress-linked hive flares.

title: Calming Routine for Vata-Type Hives
text: Maintain a steady sleep and activity routine and include calming practices like gentle breathing, since stress and irregularity are common Vata-type hive triggers.

title: Cooling Diet for Heat-Type Hives
text: Favor cooling foods and avoid spicy, fried, fermented, or previously identified allergenic foods that may trigger heat-type hive flares; track personal food triggers carefully.

title: Cool Compress for Hot Hive Flares
text: Apply a brief cool compress to red, warm welts for comfort; avoid hot showers or heat exposure during an active flare.

title: Circulation Support for Swelling-Type Hives
text: Include regular gentle movement to support circulation and lymphatic flow, which may help with Kapha-type fluid-retention hive patterns.

title: Light Warm Diet for Recurrent Swelling Hives
text: Favor light, warm meals and reduce heavy, cold, or very salty foods that may contribute to fluid retention and Kapha-type recurring welts.

title: Warm Nourishing Diet for Dry Viral Lesions
text: Favor warm, lightly oiled, nourishing meals to support skin resilience and immune balance; avoid excess dry, cold, or raw foods while lesions heal.

title: Steady Routine for Vata-Type Viral Lesions
text: Maintain a steady sleep and daily routine to support immune resilience; irregular routines can aggravate Vata and slow healing of dry, cracking lesions.

title: Gentle Moisture Care for Cracking Viral Lesions
text: Keep surrounding skin gently moisturized with a light, non-occlusive product to reduce cracking; avoid picking or scratching affected areas.

title: Cooling Immune-Support Diet for Inflamed Lesions
text: Favor cooling, mildly bitter foods that support immune balance and reduce spicy, fried, or very sour foods that may increase heat around inflamed lesions.

title: Spread-Reduction Hygiene for Pitta-Type Lesions
text: Avoid touching, scratching, or sharing towels/razors near active lesions, and reduce heat exposure, since spreading and irritation are common Pitta-type patterns.

title: Cool Gentle Cleansing for Red Spreading Lesions
text: Cleanse gently with cool water and a mild cleanser around active lesions; avoid hot water and harsh scrubbing which can worsen redness and spreading.

title: Light Warm Diet for Slow-Healing Viral Lesions
text: Favor light, warm, mildly spiced meals and reduce heavy, oily, or very sweet foods that may slow healing and increase Kapha-related congestion.

title: Circulation and Dryness Routine for Clustered Lesions
text: Include regular gentle movement to support circulation and immune function, and keep affected areas dry, since dampness can favor slow-healing Kapha-type clusters.

title: Dry-Keeping Hygiene for Damp Clustered Lesions
text: Keep the area clean and dry per clinical guidance, avoid prolonged moisture exposure (e.g. damp footwear), which can favor slow-healing Kapha-type lesion clusters.
